summary: The page only covers reviewers and editors, not authors. Reviewers and editors must keep submitted manuscripts and review materials confidential and may not upload them to public-access generative AI tools, though openly posted materials (e.g., arXiv papers) may be uploaded. Privacy-preserving AI tools conforming to RELX Responsible AI Principles may be used, and reviewers and editors remain fully responsible for the accuracy and reasoning of their reports.
